verdict.summary: Round 5 resolves the remaining major finding. bench/parse/oxttl-prefix-alloc/ab.sh now captures a machine-readable triples count and digest from every configuration and revision, compares each against the released/default reference, accumulates mismatches, and exits nonzero when any leg diverges or omits the required fields. Its self-test exercises equal results, a digest mutation with unchanged count, a count mutation, and missing fields, so the load-bearing gate is no longer merely observational or vacuous. The implementation and README/research claims are aligned, and no new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the diff.
